title: SOCIAL STUDIES-2
text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
 SCHOOL BASED ASSESSMENT
 GRADE 6 – 2022
 SOCIAL STUDIES
 SCORING GUIDE
© 2022 The Kenya National Examinations Council
1. During the class education tour, grade six learners came across the vegetation shown
 in the photograph above. Identify two characteristics of the vegetation.
 • Tall trees
 • Trees are close together
 • Trees have broad leaves
 • It is evergreen
 1 mark each Total 2 marks
2. After the lesson on preservation of culture, Mary found an old pot at home and
 brought it to class to add to the items in the cultural corner. Give two ways in which
 her class would care for the cultural artefacts.
 • Sweeping the area
 • Dusting and cleaning the artefacts
 • Repairing broken artefacts
 • Arranging the artefacts.
 1 mark each Total 2 marks
3. Some Grade six learners have joined the local ‘’ kazi kwa vijana ‘’group in their
 community to take care of the local environment. In which way are they likely to
 benefit from this interaction?
 • Learn to work together/ teamwork/unity
 • Develop problem solving skills
 • They become more responsible/ learn to keep environment clean.
 Any one correct, 1 mark
4. Jeremiah, a Grade 6 Social Studies teacher has invited a clan elder to talk to the
 learners about the functions of a clan in the traditional community. Which two
 functions of the clan could the elder have talked about?
 • Protect members against attack by other communities
 • They allowed, planned, and presided over marriage ceremonies
 • Settled disputes among members
 • Provided a sense of belonging
 • They were custodian of traditional laws/ laid down rules in the community
 Any two correct, 1 mark each Total 2 marks
5. Your class has visited a farm near the school locality to learn about horticulture
 farming. How is the local community likely to benefit from this farm?
 • It has provided employment
 • It has led to construction of roads
 • Provides nutritious food
 • Provides fresh air/clean environment
 • It has led to development of industries
 Any two correct, 1 mark each Total 2 marks
6. Tom, a Grade six learner visited his friend Juma and found him fishing in a river near
 his home. He took him the photograph shown below.
 Which method of fishing is Juma using?
 • Line fishing/hook and line
 1 mark
7. Your Class teacher has provided you with a table of minerals and where they are
 mined. Match each mineral with the place where it is mined.
 Mineral Mining area
 Soda Ash Turkana
 Diatomite Athi River
 limestone Lake Magadi
 petroleum Kariandusi
 ½ mark each Total 2 marks
8. Job, a deaf poultry farmer intends to advertise his produce using a popular means of
 communication in the area. Draw a diagram of the most suitable means of
 communication that Job may use to reach out to many people.
 correctly drawn diagram 2 marks
9. During the self-directed activities, Grade six learners decided to fill in the word
 puzzle below. Circle one quality of a good citizen from the puzzle.
 L S B A D I R O
 O I R D A I R G
 Y B A F A R M T
 A D V F P O L T
 L L H O N E S T
 O K R U G A N T
 Any correct, 1 mark
10. Grade five learners were asked to gather information on traditional leaders in Kenya.
 One learner was told by the grandfather about Kivoi wa Mwendwa. Give two
 contributions of chief Kivoi that the learner learnt?
 • He was a long-distance trader
 • He guided the first missionaries/ Dr Krapf to see Mt
 Kenya
 • He led to spread of Christianity in his community
 • He organised raids and hunting to acquire trading goods
 Any two, 1 mark each Total 2 marks
11. Your school has planned a world Human Rights Day. You have asked to present a
 short poem on respect for human rights. Write two ways of promoting respect for
 human rights that you will you put in the poem.
 • Helps citizen to live in peace and harmony
 • Promotes democracy
 • Citizens feel secure and safe
 • Children grow to be good citizens
 Any two correct, 1 mark each Total 2 marks
12. The diagram below represents the composition of the judiciary in Kenya. Fill in the
 empty branches the missing members of the judiciary.
 1 mark each Total 2 marks
 Chief justice
 Judge of supreme
 court
